# Lempel construction with q=19, alpha=2 (primitive root)
q = 19
alpha = 2
powers = {}
val = 1
for i in range(1, q-1):
    val = (val * alpha) % q
    powers[val] = i  # alpha^i = val

# For i in 1..q-2, find j such that alpha^i + alpha^j = 1 (mod q)
perm = {}
for i in range(1, q-1):
    ai = pow(alpha, i, q)
    target = (1 - ai) % q
    if target == 0:
        print("skip", i)
        continue
    j = powers[target]
    perm[i] = j

print(perm)
# Build x as 0-indexed permutation
x = [perm[c+1]-1 for c in range(17)]
print("x =", x)
print("Is permutation:", sorted(x) == list(range(17)))

# Verify Costas
vectors = set()
ok = True
for c1 in range(17):
    for c2 in range(c1+1, 17):
        v = (c2-c1, x[c2]-x[c1])
        if v in vectors:
            ok = False
            print("Duplicate:", v)
        vectors.add(v)
print("Costas valid:", ok)
